author: Dmitrii Roshchenko behind Codex (tasks)
request: Make embeddings, Jev and project knowledge configurable through Settings.
scope: Admin-only AI providers page: save, enable/disable, replace/remove credentials and test saved connections without redeploying
Project-scoped Knowledge & indexing page: connected repository, wiki folders, Graphify export, source refresh and task-embedding progress
Use saved providers in existing MCP search/index/review tools and return bounded project knowledge references in context search and Jev requests
Verify the complete browser/API/storage paths, publish the change and deploy to the existing ops stack
decisions: Retain the established Settings layout and Google-authenticated administrator boundary; no configuration or secrets tools on unauthenticated MCP
Store configuration durably in PostgreSQL; encrypt provider keys with authenticated encryption using a domain-separated key derived from the existing server secret
Treat environment values as initial defaults; saved settings explicitly take precedence, including disabling providers
Reuse each project's existing repository connections for wiki reads; accept Graphify JSON as data and never execute repository-supplied commands
Keep knowledge isolated by internal project identity, report source references and freshness, and distinguish text/graph retrieval from task-vector retrieval
Do not change Goals filters; the user cancelled that change

steps.acceptance: Admin configuration survives restart, credentials never appear in read responses, and authenticated encryption, optimistic revisions and validation are tested.
Existing indexing, search and Jev resolve saved settings; explicit connection probes and bounded background indexing report real results and errors.
Configured wiki and Graphify sources produce bounded cited context only for the selected project; unsafe paths, stale/removed sources and malformed imports are covered.
A person can configure/test providers, select project sources, refresh knowledge and start/cancel/check indexing entirely from Settings; forms do not reveal stored keys.
Applicable Rust and real-WASM tests pass; isolated PostgreSQL rollout is verified before deploying API/UI on ops with backup and rollback retained.

external_configuration: No provider key is currently configured. Do not invent credentials or claim live provider success; validate adapter contracts with controlled providers and let the administrator supply production credentials in the new Settings UI.
